hook: *GTA 6* drops Thursday. The night off starts now.
dek: GTA 6 arrives Nov 19 at $79.99, Zelda's new remake is live, and WoW just went retro.

slides.label: The Truth
slides.text: Nobody building something has time for video games, or so we tell ourselves. The ones who last know how to *put the phone down*.

slides.label: GTA 6
slides.text: *GTA 6* drops Thursday, November 19, at midnight on PS5 and Xbox. Standard is $79.99, Ultimate is $99.99.

slides.label: The Story
slides.text: Two leads, Jason and Lucia, in the state of *Leonida*. Take-Two calls it a single-player game. No PC version yet.

slides.label: After Bedtime
slides.text: GTA is made for adults. Check the rating before it hits the family console, this one waits until the kids are asleep.

slides.label: New Zelda
slides.text: *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* remake hit Switch 2 on Nov 5 and sold over *5.2 million copies* in four days.

slides.label: Family Night
slides.text: It's single-player and Switch 2 only. Pass the controller, solve it together, show them the way through the first dungeon.

slides.label: WoW: Forever
slides.text: *World of Warcraft: Forever* opened Nov 4 on PC, the classic look with new content. No ending, so set a stopping time.

slides.label: The Bottom Line
slides.text: The work will be there tomorrow. The people on your couch are there *tonight*. Pick a game, make the popcorn, log off.

GTA 6's release date, the new Zelda remake, and World of Warcraft: Forever all landed in the same week, and that timing is not an accident for people who build for a living.

Here is the quiet math behind it: Grand Theft Auto VI launches Thursday, November 19, at midnight for $79.99 standard. The Zelda remake already sold more than 5.2 million copies in four days on Nintendo Switch 2. WoW: Forever reopened the classic 2000s version of the game on PC with new content.

None of that matters as much as the pattern underneath it. The founders and operators who actually last are not the ones who never stop. The work will still be there tomorrow. The people on your couch will not wait forever.
